originalTitle: Why Intel’s stock is sinking toward its worst drop in two years
summary: Intel’s PC business is under pressure as memory-chip prices dent demand and as corporate IT teams have less budget for laptops.

chineseTitle: 为什么英特尔的股价正跌至两年来最严重的跌幅
chineseSummary: 由于内存芯片价格削弱了需求，而且企业 IT 团队对笔记本电脑的预算减少，英特尔的 PC 业务面临压力。
